subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your booking reference number is ABC123. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels, The XYZ Airlines Team
